status: Conditional turnaround candidate; fails extreme-bargain hurdle after full reinvestment
accounting_notes: NYSE ordinary common share, 1:1 with Euronext ordinary share, no ADR multiplier. Current basic plus Q2 incremental dilutive 18.903m awards. IFRS EBIT retains SBC, no addback/future award accretion. Industrial debt includes 2567m EUR leases; forecast capex includes estimated 850m EUR/year new lease/replacement obligations, growing with scale. Pension/OPEB recognized liabilities 4243m EUR deducted; 2025 plan assets of 967m EUR are not separately credited as unavailable to common holders. NCI 458m EUR deducted at book, an approximation. Hybrid principal 4997m EUR deducted once; annual 343.5025m EUR coupon reduces shareholder cash, not FCFF; coupons assumed unchanged; future reset risk remains unresolved. Captive cash 2480m and debt 28406m third-party carrying debt excluded from industrial bridge, captive equity valued by separate DDM. Remaining reset-charge cash is delta NWC, not a duplicate EBIT charge. Price/financial figures translated at frozen EURUSD 1.16276, prior-day close Sept 7; constant FX is assumption.
